m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Hello, Wizard. You do spend a lot of time in the Sewers. I seem to find that strange.
No time to talk, Ruumba. We have to find the Bat. He is lurking down here... somewhere.
Mere mention of this Bat is filling me with the sensation you organics call fear. Distinctive feeling. I recall experiencing it once before.
Where, Ruumba? Where did you feel this feeling of fear?
In the West Channel. So intense was the fear, I sealed the Bulkhead and disposed of the Key. No doubt Sani-Bots have vacuumed it up by now.
At ease, Ruumba. Fear is a powerful emotion... or so I'm told. I'll wager the Bat's somewhere in the West Channel. Let's get that Key...
Here's the Key! Along with excessive amounts of lint... Now let's go open the West Channel Bulkhead.
Shadow Creatures! We're on the right track. Let's see if they can tell us where the Bat is hiding...
*Maaaarrrggh* Alright, alright, I give. Bat's Lair is in the Runoff Drain down there.
Eh, I don't know why I keep working for that Medulla guy anyway. He keeps giving me enforcer jobs. I'm a thinker. I've got plans!
Tell us then, where would Medulla take Mellori?
Uh... I don't know. He doesn't tell me nothing. Bat probably knows, but he's gone. But that sidekick of his, Night-Thing or whatever, he'd know.
He must mean Greys'in. Let's return to the Palace. I'll contact Sparck, have him ask the King to summon his subject.
And your Medulla would be more proactive?
If Medulla had the girl, we would have won already. Your city would be ashes, the Chains would be broken and Spider would be restored.
Lucky for us then that Bat is dragging his heels. We have time to return to the Sewers and find his secret lair. Come on, Wizard, let's end this.
I see neither a rescued girl, nor the broken heap of my usurper. What happened?
Now, Lizard, tell me: where do we find the girl... Mellori?
Bat has her. Probably in his hidden lair somewhere under the city, where he spends eternity studying, waiting. For what, we don't know.
I trust Pork to sniff out the Bat's lair. He certainly has the snout for it.
